problem: The formula ρ = Σ p_i |ψ_i⟩⟨ψ_i| reads as if the state fixes the probabilities p_i and the kets |ψ_i⟩. Many different ensembles give the same ρ, and the |ψ_i⟩ need not be orthogonal, so a student may think the decomposition is unique.
fix: Add one line after the formula: this decomposition is not unique; different {p_i, |ψ_i⟩} can give the same ρ, and the |ψ_i⟩ need not be orthogonal.

problem: The sentence 'A mixed state has at least two nonzero eigenvalues' can be confused with the number of terms in the ensemble. An ensemble can have several terms and still give a pure ρ if the kets coincide.
fix: Say: a mixed state has at least two nonzero eigenvalues of ρ itself; the number of terms in an ensemble is not the same as the rank of ρ.

problem: 'Some syllabi call this topic density operators' comes after the section has already defined density operators, so the sentence is redundant and its placement is confusing.
fix: Remove it here, or move it to the first mention of density operators in the Lead.

problem: 'When A and B are separate' can be misread as spatial separation, which is not what defines a composite system; two qubits in the same trap are still A and B.
fix: Write: when A and B are two distinguishable subsystems, their joint Hilbert space is H_A ⊗ H_B.

problem: The step states the diagonal blocks but never shows why the off-diagonal entries ρ_{00,10} and ρ_{01,11} vanish, so the reader has to trust the jump.
fix: Add: the entries ρ_{00,01}, ρ_{00,10}, ρ_{01,11} and their conjugates are zero in |Φ+⟩, so each block is already diagonal.
